S.FORM: gluw na 'tayal kahul sa kay ni Yutas mu hya ga, ita' 'tayal hya ga minkahul kya pinsbkan qu inkhulan ta, maki sa rhzyal ta Taiwan qani ita 'tayal hya ga spzyang balay ghci' nyux ta' ki'an ita' hya'. misu qani hya' ga nyux ta' ps'nakun smlalu' na thawki' thayluw maha Squliq ru C'uli' ga, laha' nanak smlalu' qasa hya', ana ga lta' 'tayal hya' ga kya nanak sinllwan na nbkis sraral hya', ita' 'tayal hya' ga cyugal qu puqing balay pinsgayan ta'. qutux ga yaqu kmal maha ngasal, ru qutux hya' ga kmal maha Sali', ru yaqu maha Muyaw. yalaw gi nanak yaqu gluw na ngasal qani qu kya lalu' na puqing naha' hiya', nanu' yaqu Kinhakul qani, yani qu spzyang naha' galan puqing na qutux gluq qani, nanu' qu maha Sali' qani ga wayal naha' zngyan qu lalu' na puqing naha' lru sisay maha Mthu' laha' la, nanu' qu muyaw uzi ga, Mkmuyaw sawn uzi la. misu qani lga, kahul sa kmal maha ngasal hya ga, nyuw mgcyugal qu pinsgayan naha' la, qutux ga Mqnazi', qutux ga Mlipa', ru Haga' paris. nanu qu kmal maha Muyaw hya ga Mayspaziq ru Mnibu' ru Sqoyaw ru Plngawal spayat qu pisgayan naha' hya'. nanu' qu kmal maha Sali' hya' lga, nanu' yaqu Mbala'Nanto squ Mbala' kya Nango, ru Mks'iya' Mesawlay ru Mks'iya' Melubung, ru Mktasi', ru Maysingaw, ru Mklapay, mpitu' qu pinsgayan naha' laha', plpgun kwara lga mawpuw spayat kwara' qu ini ptnaq gluw na kkayal kwara la. taqu cyugal ini' ptnaq gluw na kkayal kay' qani ga, mqbbaq cikay mkayal qu gluw na kmal maha ngasal squ Sali' hiya, gi nanak yaqu kya "q" na gluw na ngasal hya' ga, ungat "q" na gluw na Sali' hya'. skahul sa kin ini' ptnaq na kkayal qani mita' qu cyugal gluw na pinsgayan naha' qani ga, nanak yaqu gluw na Muyaw qani qu twahiq hazi' kin muci' na kkayal naha' hya', nanu' yasa qu sawn qani mita' qu pinsgayan naha' qani ga, musa' bsyaq hazi' pinshriqan na gluw na Muyaw qani hya'! ruw taqu pinsgagay na gluw na ngasal squ Sali' qani mita' ga, musa' yaqu gluw na Sali' qu minsgagay kahul sa puqing balay kni'an na Tayal qani, gi rima' pzyux qu pinsgagay na gluw qasa hya', ta qu gluw na ngasal qani hya' lga minhlhil msgagay laha' gi ini' kpzyux na' qu pinsgayan naha' laha'.
S.PHON: ɣluw na ʔtajal kaħul [s|ɕ]a kaj ni juta[s|ɕ] mu ħja ɣa itaʔ ʔtajal ħja ɣa minkaħul kja pin[s|ɕ]βkan qu inkħulan ta maki [s|ɕ]a rħzjal ta taiwan qani ita ʔtajal ħja ɣa [s|ɕ]pzjaŋ βalaj ɣħ[ʦ|ʨ]iʔ njux taʔ kiʔan itaʔ ħjaʔ mi[s|ɕ]u qani ħjaʔ ɣa njux taʔ p[s|ɕ]ʔnakun [s|ɕ]mlaluʔ na tħawkiʔ tħajluw maħa [s|ɕ]quliq ru [ʦ|ʨ]ʔuliʔ ɣa laħaʔ nanak [s|ɕ]mlaluʔ qa[s|ɕ]a ħjaʔ ana ɣa ltaʔ ʔtajal ħjaʔ ɣa kja nanak [s|ɕ]inllwan na nβki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]raral ħjaʔ itaʔ ʔtajal ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]juɣal qu puqiŋ βalaj pin[s|ɕ]ɣajan taʔ qutux ɣa jaqu kmal maħa ŋa[s|ɕ]al ru qutux ħjaʔ ɣa kmal maħa [s|ɕ]aliʔ ru jaqu maħa mujaw jalaw ɣi nanak jaqu ɣluw na ŋa[s|ɕ]al qani qu kja laluʔ na puqiŋ naħaʔ ħijaʔ nanuʔ jaqu kinħakul qani jani qu [s|ɕ]pzjaŋ naħaʔ ɣalan puqiŋ na qutux ɣluq qani nanuʔ qu maħa [s|ɕ]aliʔ qani ɣa wajal naħaʔ zŋjan qu laluʔ na puqiŋ naħaʔ lru [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]aj maħa mtħuʔ laħaʔ la nanuʔ qu mujaw uzi ɣa mkmujaw [s|ɕ]awn uzi la mi[s|ɕ]u qani lɣa kaħul [s|ɕ]a kmal maħa ŋa[s|ɕ]al ħja ɣa njuw mɣ[ʦ|ʨ]juɣal qu pin[s|ɕ]ɣajan naħaʔ la qutux ɣa mqnaziʔ qutux ɣa mlipaʔ ru ħaɣaʔ pari[s|ɕ] nanu qu kmal maħa mujaw ħja ɣa maj[s|ɕ]paziq ru mniβuʔ ru [s|ɕ]qojaw ru plŋawal [s|ɕ]pajat qu pi[s|ɕ]ɣajan naħaʔ ħjaʔ nanuʔ qu kmal maħa [s|ɕ]aliʔ ħjaʔ lɣa nanuʔ jaqu mβalaʔnanto [s|ɕ]qu mβalaʔ kja naŋo ru mk[s|ɕ]ʔijaʔ me[s|ɕ]awlaj ru mk[s|ɕ]ʔijaʔ meluβuŋ ru mkta[s|ɕ]iʔ ru maj[s|ɕ]iŋaw ru mklapaj mpituʔ qu pin[s|ɕ]ɣajan naħaʔ laħaʔ plpɣun kwara lɣa mawpuw [s|ɕ]pajat kwaraʔ qu ini ptnaq ɣluw na kkajal kwara la taqu [ʦ|ʨ]juɣal iniʔ ptnaq ɣluw na kkajal kajʔ qani ɣa mqββaq [ʦ|ʨ]ikaj mkajal qu ɣluw na kmal maħa ŋa[s|ɕ]al [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]aliʔ ħija ɣi nanak jaqu kja q na ɣluw na ŋa[s|ɕ]al ħjaʔ ɣa uŋat q na ɣluw na [s|ɕ]aliʔ ħjaʔ [s|ɕ]kaħul [s|ɕ]a kin iniʔ ptnaq na kkajal qani mitaʔ qu [ʦ|ʨ]juɣal ɣluw na pin[s|ɕ]ɣajan naħaʔ qani ɣa nanak jaqu ɣluw na mujaw qani qu twaħiq ħaziʔ kin mu[ʦ|ʨ]iʔ na kkajal naħaʔ ħjaʔ nanuʔ ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]awn qani mitaʔ qu pin[s|ɕ]ɣajan naħaʔ qani ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ β[s|ɕ]jaq ħaziʔ pin[s|ɕ]ħriqan na ɣluw na mujaw qani ħjaʔ ruw taqu pin[s|ɕ]ɣaɣaj na ɣluw na ŋa[s|ɕ]al [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]aliʔ qani mitaʔ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ jaqu ɣluw na [s|ɕ]aliʔ qu min[s|ɕ]ɣaɣaj kaħul [s|ɕ]a puqiŋ βalaj kniʔan na tajal qani ɣi rimaʔ pzjux qu pin[s|ɕ]ɣaɣaj na ɣluw qa[s|ɕ]a ħjaʔ ta qu ɣluw na ŋa[s|ɕ]al qani ħjaʔ lɣa minħlħil m[s|ɕ]ɣaɣaj laħaʔ ɣi iniʔ kpzjux naʔ qu pin[s|ɕ]ɣajan naħaʔ laħaʔ
